headline: Casualty Rates Drop Across Major Fronts
war_summary: Since the last edition three hours ago the frenzied base‑swapping that marked Callums Cape, Linn Mercy, Mooring County and Weathered Expanse has markedly eased. Callums Cape still logs the highest hourly losses — roughly 680 Colonial and 860 Warden — but both streams have turned from accelerating to cooling, and only two bases moved in the past two hours. Linn Mercy’s casualty flow has collapsed to about 105 Colonial and 220 Warden per hour, down from the earlier surge, though seven base events keep the sector lively. Mooring County, previously the deadliest theatre, now records 765 Colonial and 640 Warden losses per hour, both cooling, with no fresh base changes in the last two hours. Weathered Expanse shows a similar decline to 300 Colonial and 200 Warden per hour, yet six base events in the same window signal continued contention. Marban Hollow has gone quiet, registering only a handful of casualties and steady enlistments. Stlican Shelf is the lone front where losses are rising again, with Colonial and Warden rates accelerating to 33 and 94 per hour alongside three recent base flips. Elsewhere the line remains largely static.
